experimental_design: Two sets were done for each experiment, Forward (unmodified-light, acylated-heavy) and Reverse (unmodified-heavy, acylated-light).
number_of_biological_replicates: At least three biological replicates were performed for each condition.
number_of_technical_replicates: Signals from the three technical replicate wells were averaged for further analysis.
technology_type: Data acquisition was executed in data dependent mode with full MS scans acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer and selection of top 20 ions with dynamic exclusion followed by collision induced dissociation (CID) analysis of fragment ions in the ion trap with rapid scan rate.
